title: LDN RTM
idiom: bold pop-art screenprint, a manual bristling with tabs, every section marked
hero_prompt: Bold 1960s pop-art screenprint with flat colours and halftone dots, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink and halftone texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a very thick instruction book lying open on a bright studio table, its pages plain and blank, with dozens of small brightly coloured paper tabs bristling from its edges so every section is marked, and a little video camera on a tripod standing beside it, pointed at the book. Nothing else on the table. Hot pink, cyan, yellow and black.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a hot pink ground, no shading or gradients: a thick closed book seen from the side with a row of many tabs bristling from its edge. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
